records.title: On Approximation Behavior of the Greedy Triangulation for Convex Polygons
records.author: Christos Levcopoulos; Andrzej Lingas
records.notes: S023 2026-10-14: FULL university-hosted original Algorithmica 2 (1987) 175–193 visually inspected across the complete scanned 10-image PDF, original printed pp.175–193. §2 definition 2.1 locally optimal triangulation, Lemmas 2.1–2.5 and Theorem 2.1; §3 q-open polygon Theorem 3.1; §4 Theorems 4.1–4.3 and semicircular property; original references pp.192–193 inspected. Greedy triangulation adds shortest compatible polygon diagonals, with crossing rejection and no chronological compulsory nearest-two predecessor connections. A semicircular polygon is a special configuration, not all ellipse boundary subsets; no all-n ellipse ratio theorem observed in this paper. This PROOF_INSPECTED upgrade is solely for this accessible 1987 original, not other historical works. Original S022 first-page ABSTRACT_INSPECTED observation remains in S022 archive.
